# telnyx_porting_order_associated_phone_number (Resource)

A phone number range associated with a porting order, and what to do with it when the order completes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# In a partial port, keep the rest of the range with the current carrier.
resource "telnyx_porting_order_associated_phone_number" "example" {
  porting_order_id = telnyx_porting_order.example.id
  action           = "keep"
  phone_number_range = {
    start_at = "+13125550125"
    end_at   = "+13125550129"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Specifies the action to take with this phone number during partial porting. One of `disconnect`, `keep`.
- `phone_number_range` (Attributes) Specifies the phone number range for this associated phone number. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_range))
- `porting_order_id` (String) Identifies the porting order associated with this phone number.

### Read-Only

- `country_code` (String) Specifies the country code for this associated phone number. It is a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this associated phone number.
- `phone_number_type` (String) Specifies the phone number type for this associated phone number.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_range`

Optional:

- `end_at` (String) Specifies the end of the phone number range for this associated phone number.
- `start_at` (String) Specifies the start of the phone number range for this associated phone number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_porting_order_associated_phone_number.example <porting_order_id>/<id>
```
